description: Introduction of a new procedure to be followed by the National Transport Commission when issuing Inter-Provincial Passenger Service Permits
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023.12.11 to implement a new procedure to be adopted when issuing inter-provincial passenger service permits. After reviewing the new procedure prepared accordingly and taking also into consideration the criteria set out in the National Transport Commission (Amendment) Act, No.8 of 2025 as well, the National Transport Commission has prepared a new procedure to issue inter-provincial passenger service permits. The said procedure has been prepared so as to protect the existing bus owners actively engaged in the passenger transport sector and ensuring the passengers’ right to access a quality service by expanding opportunities for new investors to provide public transport services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport Highways and Urban Development to implement the new methodology to issue inter-provincial passenger service permits, was approved by the Cabinet.
